description: From the park across the Sil the Templar castle of Ponferrada fills the hill, its round towers and crenellated walls washed in warm floodlight under the cloudy night sky. The great keep rises above the enclosure, and dark park trees frame the view while the river glints below. Visitors call the castle at night a sight not to be missed — the lighting gives the whole fortress a more dramatic presence after dark.
